method.source: PostHog project 155556, HogQL, events with properties.$lib = 'posthog-react-native', timestamp >= now() - 120 days (2026-07-06 .. 2026-11-03)
method.country: each person assigned to the country most frequent in their events' $geoip_country_code (topK(1)); persons that travel are counted once
method.id_resolution_note: PostHog persons carry no email property (emails are not sent to PostHog), so the three truncated ids were resolved by id prefix and matched to accounts via the team's test-account filter notes (reference_posthog_test_account_filters memory).

feature_event_map.rides_tracked: ride_started (attempted GPS ride); rides_finished = ride_completed OR ride_ended
feature_event_map.trips: trip_viewed (trip detail opened, includes viewing discovered/shared trips), trip_plan_viewed, trip_waypoint_added, gpx_download_clicked; trip_building = trip_waypoint_added only
feature_event_map.ai_diagnosis: diagnostic_started OR diagnostic_submitted (out of positioning scope)
feature_event_map.bike_added: bike_added OR garage_bike_added (mostly fired by onboarding, so it measures onboarding, not feature choice)

method.denominator: users = distinct persons with any mobile event in the window

ranking_by_distinct_users.note: only 35 (3.1%) built a trip (added a waypoint); the rest opened a trip detail
out of positioning scope, never lead with it
highest repeat use: 176 expense_added events from 52 people (~3.4 each)

global.vs_prior_findings: Matches the October 2026 finding that rides are the most-used feature. The earlier 'expenses > maintenance > rides' order no longer holds by distinct users; expenses still have the most repeat use per user. Onboarding primary goal in the same window (454 persons): track_rides 254 (56%), maintain_bike 83 (18%), manage_expenses 54 (12%), just_exploring 51 (11%), discover_routes 12 (3%). Close to the ~60% track_rides seen before.
global.order_rationale: Rides lead clearly. Trips rank 2nd only when trip-detail views are counted; by trip building (35) they fall below maintenance (67) and roughly level with expenses (51). Maintenance and expenses are also the two confirmed ASO benefits (NEVER MISS A SERVICE, TRACK EVERY EXPENSE). If the team prefers to count trip views, swap trips to slot 2.
